[quickClaude]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; agenc mission new --blank >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[talkToAgenc]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; agenc mission new --adjutant >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[showNotifications]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux display-popup -e AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42 -E -w 95% -h 90% "agenc notification manage" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[newMission]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux display-popup -e AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42 -E -w 68% -h 63% "agenc mission new" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[switchMission]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux display-popup -e AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42 -E -w 85% -h 80% "agenc mission attach" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[detachMission]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; agenc mission detach $AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[sideShell]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux split-window -h -c "${AGENC_DIRPATH:-$HOME/.agenc}/missions/$AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID/agent" $SHELL >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[draft]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux split-window -h -d "agenc mission draft $AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID" ; sleep 0.5 ; tmux copy-mode -t "$AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[shell]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux new-window -a -c "${AGENC_DIRPATH:-$HOME/.agenc}/missions/$AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID/agent" $SHELL >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[copyMissionUuid]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; printf '%s' $AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID | pbcopy >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[renameSession]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux display-popup -e AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42 -E -w 68% -h 63% "agenc mission rename $AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[stopMission]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; agenc mission stop $AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[reloadMission]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; agenc mission reload $AGENC_CALLING_MISSION_UUID >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[removeMission]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux display-popup -e AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42 -E -w 68% -h 63% "agenc mission rm" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[nukeMissions]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux display-popup -e AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42 -E -w 68% -h 63% "agenc mission nuke" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[stashWorkspace]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux display-popup -e AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42 -E -w 68% -h 63% "agenc stash push" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[restoreWorkspace]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux display-popup -e AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42 -E -w 68% -h 63% "agenc stash pop" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[exitTmux]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; tmux detach >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[sendFeedback]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; agenc mission new --adjutant --prompt "I'd like to send feedback about AgenC" >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[joinDiscord]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; agenc discord >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1

[starAgenc]
export AGENC_DIRPATH=<AGENC_DIRPATH>; export AGENC_CALLING_PANE_ID=%42; agenc star >> <AGENC_DIRPATH>/logs/palette.log 2>&1
